description: Suggest an RSS or Atom feed for the index. No key needed. An admin reviews every suggestion before anything is fetched; approved podcast feeds are handed to rssamplifier, everything else becomes a source here.

collection.description: Collection slug it belongs in (optional; an admin decides otherwise)

email.description: Where to hear back, if you are not sending a key (optional)

note.description: Why it belongs here: who publishes it, what it covers (optional)

url.description: The feed URL, starting with https://

name: submit_feed
